decisions.reason: Because this printer is very close to the firm's core hardware, ink and integration knowledge, management would normally keep and refine it, though the lack of later website evidence raises some replacement or portfolio-consolidation risk.
This coder uses the firm's established inkjet and substrate expertise for a clear customer problem, so absorptive capacity argues for continued learning and improvement rather than withdrawal.
The decoding app fits the firm's move toward serialization and traceability and builds on prior app knowledge, although software products can be superseded relatively quickly if adoption is modest.
Inline code verification is strongly complementary to the firm's marking systems and future traceability focus, making retention the likely management choice.

Print layout design software reinforces integrated system use and common operation across the installed base, so a growing R&D-intensive machinery firm would usually keep it unless it is folded into another software package.
